title: IIT Hyderabad Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Various Research Associate I Posts
description: The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT Hyderabad) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various Research Associate I Jobs. Candidates who have qualified for the Ph.D. in Civil Engineering can use this opportunity and apply for the IIT Hyderabad Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. The application process has already started.
